finding: GUI running-target termination logged Connection close timeout before controller disconnect
sourceAnalysis: JDBCExecutionContext.disconnect invokes JDBCDataSource.closeConnection with rollback for the non-autocommit target. GaussDBDebugSession previously closed that target before the busy autocommit controller.
change: When controllerLock is busy, disconnect controller first, then target under transactionLock. Target close remains in finally; controller lock release is protected even if controller close throws.
testScope: Real compiled production session in OSGi, mocked contexts and lock held by a separate thread; asserts close order, not actual socket cancellation latency
